messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a slightly low-angle full-body shot from a front three-quarter view. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the described camera setup and movement, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to a slightly low-angle full-body shot from a front three-quarter view. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man stands mostly still, turning his head to look around, then briefly raises his right hand to his face before lowering it and shifting his weight slightly.","camera":"A static, low-angle full-body shot frames the man from head to toe against the background.","clothing":"He wears a light plaid button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, brown leather suspenders, dark gray jeans, and dark brown shoes.","hair_color":"Dark brown or black.","hairstyle":"Short, dark hair cropped close to the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered adult man with a medium-brown complexion, short dark hair, and a short beard stands in the center of the frame.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor paved road or plaza beneath a large concrete overpass, with red-and-yellow striped construction barriers, a metal guardrail, and a construction crane visible in the distance under a bright, partly cloudy sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output is a static low-angle full-body shot from a front three-quarter view, matching the reference framing with the man centered under an overpass and construction barriers visible. His outfit and general identity remain the same, and he remains mostly still with small head movements and a hand-to-face gesture.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a slightly low-angle full-body shot from a front three-quarter view, using the reference for initial direction, placement, and framing, while preserving the same person, appearance, outfit, action, timing, and environment.
uncertain: Whether the subtle facial expression was fully preserved.
unexpected_changes: The source camera movement and changing background views were replaced by a static camera setup.
The man's hairstyle appears shorter and cropped in the output rather than the longer tied-back style seen in much of the source.
The action progression differs: the source shows a continuous turn/walk, while the output shows mostly standing with brief head turns and a hand-to-face gesture.
